_comment: Axes for the readable vector (references/pattern-readable-vector.md). One question = one coordinate. Write the questions for YOUR corpus: this template triages incoming messages. type is noul (yes/no), choice (one of N, give a description per option) or score (ordered levels, lowest first). weight defaults to 1 and is not part of the axes hash, so re-weighting never forces re-profiling. Keep questions literal and in English: Jev reads literally and is trained mostly on English; the texts may be Russian.

axes.name: needs_reply
axes.instructions: Does the message ask the recipient for an answer or an action?

axes.name: time_sensitive
axes.instructions: Does the message state or imply a deadline within the next few days?

axes.name: money
axes.instructions: Is the message about a payment, an invoice, a price or a refund?

axes.name: complaint
axes.instructions: Is the sender unhappy about something that already happened?

axes.name: kind
axes.instructions: What kind of message is this?

options.request: asks for something to be done
options.question: asks for information
options.notice: announces something with no reply expected

axes.name: urgency
axes.instructions: How urgent is the message for the recipient?
